description:
Top 10 anime where arrogant nobles underestimate the MC and instantly regret it. From overpowered protagonists to genius masterminds, these anime deliver some of the most satisfying humiliation moments in anime history.

In this video, we cover anime like Black Clover, The Eminence in Shadow, Shield Hero, Chivalry of a Failed Knight, Saga of Tanya the Evil, and more—where prideful nobles and elites get completely exposed by the main character.

If you enjoy:

Overpowered MC anime
Magic academy anime
Revenge anime
Underdog protagonists
Noble humiliation moments
Power fantasy anime

Then this list is for you.
10 Times Arrogant Nobles Realized They Messed Up
